name: Note sorter
author: Brett
description: Sorts new and edited notes with AI (mode ai.chat, one short JSON reply): category, tags, title, short summary and action items. Files notes into matching lists, turns action items into to-dos on a chosen to-do list, learns from your re-categorizations (examples in the prompt, and local rules when AI is unavailable), and writes a daily or weekly digest note meant to be read aloud. Settings: categories, auto-sort, summary length, target to-do list, digest.

keeps: Notes, categories, tags and to-dos it made stay yours after uninstall (digest notes carry the tag digest).

hostActions.axnotes.notes.saved: watched: the app dispatches it after saving a note (payload = the note JSON); new or edited notes get sorted
hostActions.axnotes.notes.save: the app saves a note from payload {id?, title, text, tags[], source, category?, fileInto[]?}: with id it updates that note; category is a name (resolved or created); fileInto names note lists to add the note to when one by that name exists
hostActions.axnotes.todos.add: the app adds a to-do from payload {list, text, noteId?, category?, createList?} (list = to-do list name; skip when an open item with the same text is on it); without it action items are not turned into to-dos
hostActions.axnotes.notes.announce: optional: the app dispatches axnotes.notes.saved again for every note (Sort all notes now covers older notes)
